author: Cinna Davis (OpenAI Codex assisted)
statement: A uniform actual rational crossing family normalizes a nonprincipal minor of the charged first-moment pairing, omits the central s=0 piece, and preserves both required flattening ranks through a local x-axis inverse. The minimal grade has h=Theta(lambda^2) and p(h)<h^2*2^lambda; rational generation and normalization cost 2^O(lambda). The inherited rho=1/sqrt(2) and selected alpha are unchanged. A limited charge-independent high-coefficient support-rank lemma is supplied for future filters; no central interval filter is achieved.
remaining_obligations: Independent review of the actual asymmetric crossing and uniform time/rank proofs, retaining predecessor evidence boundaries
A valid scalar filter removing a fixed central interval without losing leading label/output capacity or either rank bound
The supplied envelope does not improve rho; a smaller actual-rank theorem or changed family remains necessary
Full master/SAT implementation and polynomial-space compilation are not supplied
ai_assistance: Substantial OpenAI Codex assistance; author-checked, no independent or formal review
